title.en: Use resonance and the R effect
Explain the electromeric effect and hyperconjugation

say.en: Put one chlorine atom on acetic acid and it becomes nearly a hundred times stronger. Chlorine pulls electrons along the chain, and that pull changes everything. In this lesson: Explain the inductive effect.
Use resonance and the R effect.
Explain the electromeric effect and hyperconjugation.

body.en: The *inductive* effect is a permanent shift of σ-electrons towards a more electronegative atom; it weakens quickly along the chain. Groups like –NO₂, –CN, –COOH and halogens are electron-withdrawing (−I); alkyl groups are electron-releasing (+I). The electromeric effect is a temporary, complete shift of a π-electron pair to one atom, only when an attacking reagent is present.
body.kn: ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮ σ-ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ; −NO₂, −CN, ಹ್ಯಾಲೋಜನ್‌ಗಳು −I, ಆಲ್ಕೈಲ್ ಗುಂಪುಗಳು +I. ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರೋಮೆರಿಕ್ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಕಾರಕ ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಆಗುವ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ π-ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ.

The electromeric effect is a temporary, complete shift of a π-electron pair to one atom, only when an attacking reagent is present.

say.en: The inductive effect is a permanent shift of sigma -electrons towards a more electronegative atom; it weakens quickly along the chain. Groups like -NO 2, -CN, -COOH and halogens are electron-withdrawing (-I); alkyl groups are electron-releasing plus I. The electromeric effect is a temporary, complete shift of a pi -electron pair to one atom, only when an attacking reagent is present. -I: -NO 2, -CN, -COOH, -F, -Cl, -Br.
say.kn: ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮ sigma -ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ; -NO 2, -CN, ಹ್ಯಾಲೋಜನ್‌ಗಳು -I, ಆಲ್ಕೈಲ್ ಗುಂಪುಗಳು plus I. ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರೋಮೆರಿಕ್ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಕಾರಕ ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಆಗುವ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ pi -ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ.

say.en: plus I: -CH 3, -C 2H 5.
-I groups strengthen carboxylic acids.
Electromeric: temporary, needs a reagent.
Chlorine pulls the sigma electrons towards itself. The carbon next to it becomes slightly positive, and the effect fades quickly along the chain.
More electron-withdrawing chlorines stabilise the anion and make the acid stronger: pKa falls from 4.8 for acetic acid to 0.7 for trichloroacetic acid.
Resonance: benzene is a hybrid of two Kekulé structures. All six carbon–carbon bonds are equal, 139 picometres, so we draw a circle in the ring.
Groups like OH and NH2 push electrons into a pi system, plus R; groups like NO2, CHO and CN pull them out, minus R. Hyperconjugation lets C–H bonds next to a carbocation share their electrons.
Inductive effect, resonance and hyperconjugation.

narration.en: Put halogen atoms on the CH₃ of ethanoic acid. Each halogen pulls electron density along the σ bonds (−I effect), stabilises the carboxylate ion and makes the acid stronger (lower pKa). Fluorine pulls hardest.
narration.kn: ಎಥನೋಯಿಕ್ ಆಮ್ಲದ CH₃ ಗೆ ಹ್ಯಾಲೋಜನ್ ಸೇರಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹ್ಯಾಲೋಜನ್ σ ಬಂಧಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್ ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ (−I), ಆಮ್ಲ ಬಲವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ (pKa ಕಡಿಮೆ). ಫ್ಲೋರಿನ್ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: When one structure cannot describe a molecule, it is a *resonance* hybrid of several structures, and it is more stable than any of them. In benzene all six C–C bonds are equal, 139 pm. Groups that push electrons into a π system show +R (–OH, –OR, –NH₂, halogens); groups that pull them show −R (–NO₂, –CHO, –COOH, –CN). Hyperconjugation is delocalisation of C–H σ electrons of an alkyl group into an adjacent empty p orbital or π bond; more α-hydrogens mean more stabilisation.
body.kn: ಒಂದೇ ರಚನೆ ಅಣುವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಲು ಸಾಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದು ಅನುರಣನ ಸಂಕರ. ಬೆಂಜೀನಿನ ಎಲ್ಲ C–C ಬಂಧಗಳು 139 pm. ಹೈಪರ್‌ಕಾಂಜುಗೇಶನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ α-ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್‌ಗಳ C–H σ ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳು ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: Purification and analysis of organic compounds

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. The inductive effect is a permanent sigma -electron shift that fades along the chain.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಸರಪಳಿಯ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೂ ಕ್ಷೀಣಿಸುವ ಶಾಶ್ವತ sigma -ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ.

say.en: The electromeric effect is temporary and needs an attacking reagent.
A resonance hybrid is more stable than any single structure.
say.kn: ಅನುರಣನ ಸಂಕರ ಯಾವುದೇ ಒಂದು ರಚನೆಗಿಂತ ಸ್ಥಿರ.

say.en: Hyperconjugation: more alpha -hydrogens, more stability.
Next: Purification and analysis of organic compounds.
say.kn: ಮುಂದೆ: ಸಾವಯವ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತಗಳ ಶುದ್ಧೀಕರಣ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ.
